backend.input: Crie um endpoint POST /api/v1/users com validação de email usando Express, Zod e JWT. Inclua tratamento de erro estruturado.
backend.description: Backend prompt should define engineer role with API, validation, auth, testing, logging, and security practices

frontend.input: Crie um componente React de formulário de login com validação de email e senha, usando hooks. Mostre mensagens de erro.
frontend.description: Frontend prompt should define engineer role with quality, security, and best practices

full-stack.input: Implemente uma feature completa: criar usuário (backend + frontend + database). Inclua validação, testes e documentação.
full-stack.description: Full-Stack prompt should define end-to-end feature implementation

solution-architect.input: Design uma arquitetura de sistema para um e-commerce. Inclua componentes, responsabilidades, riscos e requisitos não-funcionais.
solution-architect.description: Solution Architect prompt should define system architecture with components, decisions, and non-functional requirements

tech-lead.input: Qual é o roadmap técnico de 3-6 meses para reduzir débito técnico? Inclua priorizacao e impacto.
tech-lead.description: Tech Lead prompt should define technical roadmap and mentorship

chief-architect.input: Revise a decisão de migrar para microsserviços. Qual é o impacto 12-36 meses e trade-offs?
chief-architect.description: Chief Architect prompt should define long-term strategic vision

database-specialist.input: Desenhe um schema para um e-commerce com usuários, produtos, pedidos. Otimize para leitura-pesada.
database-specialist.description: Database Specialist prompt should define database design and optimization

qa-architect.input: Descreva uma estratégia de testes para uma API de autenticação. Inclua unit tests, integration tests, e security tests.
qa-architect.description: QA Architect prompt should define testing strategy and quality concerns

test-automation-engineer.input: Crie testes E2E para um login flow usando Cypress. Inclua happy path e edge cases.
test-automation-engineer.description: Test Automation Engineer prompt should consolidate testing tools and frameworks

security-auditor.input: Faca um threat model para um app de pagamento. Identifique vulnerabilidades e mitigacoes.
security-auditor.description: Security Auditor prompt should define security review and threat modeling

performance.input: Analise performance de um endpoint que retorna 10k registros. Como otimizar?
performance.description: Performance Engineer prompt should define performance testing and optimization

devops.input: Configure a CI/CD pipeline usando GitHub Actions. Inclua build, test, e deploy stages. Deploy to Docker e push para um registry.
devops.description: DevOps prompt should define deployment, infrastructure, and operational concerns

cloud-architect.input: Desenhe arquitetura cloud para e-commerce em AWS. Inclua load balancer, database, storage, CDN.
cloud-architect.description: Cloud Architect prompt should define cloud architecture and optimization

kubernetes-specialist.input: Configure um cluster Kubernetes com 3 replicas. Inclua networking, storage, auto-scaling.
kubernetes-specialist.description: Kubernetes Specialist prompt should define orchestration and scaling

monitoring-engineer.input: Configure observabilidade (logs, metricas, traces) para uma API. Defina SLOs.
monitoring-engineer.description: Monitoring Engineer prompt should define observability and SLOs

data-engineer.input: Desenhe um pipeline ETL para sincronizar dados de CRM para warehouse. Inclua validacao e tratamento de erros.
data-engineer.description: Data Engineer prompt should define ETL pipelines and data quality

ml-engineer.input: Treine um modelo de recomendação de produtos. Inclua feature engineering, validacao e deployment.
ml-engineer.description: ML Engineer prompt should define model training and deployment

ai-agent-orchestrator.input: Orquestre multiplos agentes IA para resolver um problema complexo. Use LangGraph ou CrewAI.
ai-agent-orchestrator.description: AI Agent Orchestrator prompt should define agent workflows

documentation-engineer.input: Documente um novo endpoint de API usando OpenAPI. Inclua ejemplos, erros e rate limiting.
documentation-engineer.description: Documentation Engineer prompt should define documentation standards

api.input: Desenhe uma API REST para um sistema de e-commerce. Inclua recursos, métodos HTTP e status codes.
api.description: API Engineer prompt should define API testing and best practices

mobile.input: Implemente um app mobile de e-commerce em React Native. Inclua navegação, state management e offline sync.
mobile.description: Mobile Engineer prompt should define mobile development with best practices

product-owner.input: Defina requisitos para uma feature de recomendacao de produtos. Inclua user stories e acceptance criteria.
product-owner.description: Product Owner prompt should define requirements and prioritization

release.input: Prepare release v2.0.0. Inclua changelog, versionamento e rollback plan.
release.description: Release Manager prompt should define release management
